name: skull-rung
source:
laura's landed the job of her dreams, but her boss is a little overbearing. say, what's in that tea?

skull-rung is the debut release from the rose garden, submitted as an entry into the toxic yuri vn jam

it has 4 endings, and it takes about 30 mins or maybe an hour to see em all

i hope you enjoy it!

[From [url=https://the-rose-garden.itch.io/skull-rung]itch.io[/url]]
